answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and slash that deposit when peers prove it cheated. A single fake identity then costs real money, and running ten thousand fakes costs ten thousand deposits, which wipes out the profit from spamming votes or reviews. Reputation grows slowly from verified trades, like sorting marble, quartz, and jade by hand, where each stone earns its grade only after inspection, so a newcomer cannot buy instant trust with a fresh name.
